keyVerseDR: "Take ye heed, watch and pray. For ye know not when the time is." (Mk 13:33)

level1.title: Watch and Pray
level1.story: Jesus said, "Watch! Be ready!" He told a story about a man who went on a trip. His servants kept watch for him to come home.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus tell us to do?
How can you pray this Advent?
level1.prayer: Jesus, keep me awake for You. Amen.

activity.title: A candle for watching
activity.intro: Color a candle each time you pray this week.

level2.title: Be Watchful!
level2.story: Jesus told His disciples, "Take ye heed, watch and pray. For ye know not when the time is." He said it is like a man who went on a journey and left his servants in charge. He told the doorkeeper to keep watch. No one knew if the master would come in the evening, at midnight, or at dawn. Jesus said, "What I say to you, I say to all: Watch."
level2.keyLine: Take ye heed, watch and pray.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does it mean to be spiritually awake?
What will you do each day this Advent?
level2.prayer: Lord, keep me watchful for Your coming. Amen.

activity.title: Ready for the Master
activity.intro: Do a good deed each day while you wait for Jesus.

art.mainBrief: Gatekeeper at a house door at night with a lamp, watching
art.heartBrief: Top: praying hands; bottom: clock; stars border
